title: Zymo Extraction Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the Zymo Elution Plate (clean, empty) in slot 1; load a 24‑well tube rack with 2 mL tubes in slot 2 (A1 Proteinase K, A2 Magbeads, B1 DNase/RNase‑Free Water, B2 DNase/RNase‑Free Water); load a 6‑well tube rack with 50 mL Falcon tubes in slot 3 (A1 Pathogen DNA/RNA Buffer, A2 Wash Buffer 1, B2 Wash Buffer 2, A3 Ethanol, B3 Ethanol); install the Magnetic Module in slot 4; ensure any additional labware (e.g., NEST 1‑Channel Reservoir, 195 mL) is positioned as required.

steps.title: Load pipettes and tips
steps.instruction: Mount the Opentrons P50 single‑channel pipette and the Opentrons P1000 single‑channel pipette on the robot; load Opentrons 50/300 µL tip racks for the P50 and Opentrons 1000 µL tip racks for the P1000.

steps.title: Download protocol bundle
steps.instruction: Download the zipped protocol bundle from the provided source and unzip it on your computer.

steps.title: Upload labware definition
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 App, upload the custom labware definition file for any non‑standard labware (e.g., Zymo Block Plate); this needs to be done only once.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the extracted protocol file (compatible with OT‑2 Run App version 3.15.0 or later) into the OT‑2 App.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 App, perform calibration of the deck, labware, tip racks, and both pipettes with calibration tips (only required once).

steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter any required protocol parameters (e.g., number of samples, split mode up to 48 elutes six columns apart).

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App to start the Zymo extraction; the robot will process the samples according to the loaded protocol.
